## Technical Structure & Archive Sections

### 1. Android Tools (`/archive/android-tools/`)
Browser-friendly utilities for Android workflows:
- FRP Bypass Helper: Web-based intent launcher to open Android settings and system activities from the browser.

### 2. Documentation & Research (`/docs/`)
Technical notes covering Android platform behavior, chipset research, and tooling write-ups.

### 3. Web Tools (`/archive/web-tools/`)
Lightweight browser-based client-side tools:
- gh-boards: Generate GitHub profile stat badges and boards.
- Text Formatter: Browser utility to format text and adjust casing/spacing.
- FPS Tester: Display refresh rate and frame delivery tester.

### 4. LLM Automation (`llm-adb`)
Token-efficient ADB wrapper for LLMs to inspect and manage Android devices.
